error.invalid_contracted_power_periods: Contracted-power assignments are invalid, overlapping, or have an end date before the start date.
error.source_not_found: The selected sensor does not exist. Check the entity and try again.
error.invalid_source_unit: The selected sensor has an unsupported unit. Power requires W or kW; energy counters require Wh or kWh.
error.invalid_counter_state_class: The cumulative sensor must use Home Assistant state class total or total_increasing.
error.invalid_net_counter_state_class: A bidirectional net-energy counter must use Home Assistant state class total. total_increasing cannot represent legitimate reverse-flow decreases.
error.invalid_source_value: The current sensor state is not numeric. Wait for a valid reading or select another sensor.
error.negative_nonnegative_source: This source must be nonnegative. Select a dedicated import/export sensor or use signed-power mode.
error.conflicting_power_sources: Import and export are both positive. The two readings cannot safely represent one grid connection.
error.archive_delete_confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation does not match. Type the exact phrase shown before permanent deletion.

user.title: Meter source
user.description: Recommended: choose signed live grid power when available. Otherwise use separate import/export power, import-only power for a one-way sensor, or cumulative counters when only Wh/kWh energy entities exist. Every mode feeds the same import-only billing engine.

data_description.meter_name: A clear name shown on every dashboard page, for example Main Grid, Garage or Workshop.
data_description.source_mode: Choose signed power, separate import/export power, import-only power, or cumulative energy counters.

counter_type.title: Cumulative counter type
counter_type.description: Choose how this counter behaves. SI Grid Monitor creates its own derived-power entities; no YAML, Template Sensor or Derivative helper is needed.

data_description.counter_behavior: Import-only counters never decrease during export. Bidirectional net counters may increase or decrease; choose the direction on the next screen. Separate counters preserve independently measured import and export. A net counter may use state class total; an import-only or separate monotonic counter normally uses total_increasing.
data_description.counter_min_observation_seconds: Counter changes observed sooner than this are accumulated instead of converted into a misleading spike. Default 30 seconds. Energy is retained until enough observation time exists.
data_description.counter_max_plausible_power_kw: Meter-specific safety ceiling for a derived interval average. Values above it are rejected as anomalous and cannot create a confirmed exceedance. This is not the contractual target or breaker rating.

meter.title: Measurement source
meter.description: Choose the sensor fields shown for this source mode. Power accepts W/kW; cumulative energy accepts Wh/kWh.

data_description.power_entity: Select the grid-connection power sensor (W or kW), not total house consumption or PV production. Current readings will be normalized into import (+) and export (−).
data_description.positive_means_import: For live power, enable if a positive reading means grid import. For a bidirectional net-energy counter, enable if the counter increases during import (default); disable if it increases during export. Review the preview before continuing.
data_description.import_power_entity: A nonnegative W or kW grid-import reading.
data_description.export_power_entity: A nonnegative W or kW grid-export reading.
data_description.import_energy_entity: Select a Wh or kWh counter from Settings > Devices & services > Entities. For bidirectional-net mode this is the one signed/net counter; for the other counter modes it is cumulative import.
data_description.export_energy_entity: For separate-counter mode only: an optional cumulative Wh or kWh export counter. Without it, export remains unknown.

polarity_preview.title: Check normalized source
polarity_preview.description: {preview} Review direction, units, measurement type and unavailable capabilities before continuing.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

contract.title: Contracted-power validity
contract.description: Dates are inclusive local dates. The optional record date and provenance preserve the distributor assignment's audit trail.

data_description.assignment_start_date: First local calendar date on which this contracted-power assignment applies (inclusive). For example, 2026-01-01.
data_description.assignment_end_date: Last local calendar date for these limits (inclusive). The system does not silently extend the assignment into future years.
data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date printed or recorded on the distributor's assignment. This is evidence/provenance, not the start of validity.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Identify who provided these limits, for example 'distributor assignment'. Kept with archived contract metadata.

target_mode.title: Contracted-power mode
target_mode.description: A contracted limit is a 15-minute average import-demand target, not instantaneous breaker or phase capacity.

data_description.target_mode: Use one shared kW limit for B1–B5, or enter five independent limits. These are limits for 15-minute import demand, not electrical breaker capacity.

shared_target.title: Shared B1-B5 target
shared_target.description: This value will be saved for all five tariff blocks in the dated assignment.

data_description.target_kw: Agreed 15-minute average IMPORT power in kW. Shared mode copies this exact limit into all five tariff blocks for the selected dates.

individual_targets.title: Individual B1-B5 targets
individual_targets.description: Enter the distributor-assigned 15-minute contracted power for every block.

data_description.target_b1_kw: Distributor-assigned B1 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B1 applies.
data_description.target_b2_kw: Distributor-assigned B2 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B2 applies.
data_description.target_b3_kw: Distributor-assigned B3 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B3 applies.
data_description.target_b4_kw: Distributor-assigned B4 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B4 applies.
data_description.target_b5_kw: Distributor-assigned B5 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B5 applies.

calculation.title: Calculation settings
calculation.description: Defaults may be submitted unchanged. Provisional 2028-2030 tariff continuation is disabled unless explicitly enabled.

data.allow_provisional_tariff: Allow provisional tariffs for unverified years

data_description.safety_margin_kw: Optional planning buffer (kW) subtracted from the agreed limit when calculating operational headroom. Default 0.00 kW; does not change the contract.
data_description.smoothing_seconds: Averages recent signed power for the end-of-quarter forecast. 30 s reacts faster; 120 s is steadier but slower to follow changes.
data_description.sustained_horizon_minutes: How long (15/30/60/120 min) continuous extra demand is evaluated, including any stricter tariff blocks coming next.
data_description.retention: How long completed 15-minute quarters remain in the integration-owned SQLite database. 'Forever' preserves them across normal HA recorder purges.
data_description.allow_provisional_tariff: Opt in to explicitly provisional continuation of the 2027 block pattern for unverified years 2028–2030. Without opt-in no future block/limit is claimed as confirmed.
data_description.simulation_enabled: Use a temporary comparison threshold without changing the distributor-assigned B1–B5 schedule. Simulated results never count as confirmed contractual statistics.
data_description.simulation_target_kw: Temporary kW threshold used only while simulation is enabled. It does not overwrite dated contracted-power assignments or archived provenance.

archive_removal.title: Archive behavior when this meter is removed
archive_removal.description: Meter: {meter}. Native removal safely keeps its schema-6 SQLite archive. A permanent-deletion confirmation expires after 10 minutes; remove this exact config entry within that window or the archive is retained.

data.archive_removal_backup: Create a SQLite backup before permanent deletion

data_description.archive_removal_action: Keep preserves the database for manual recovery. Delete permanently removes only this meter's database and owned WAL/SHM sidecars after runtime shutdown.
data_description.archive_removal_backup: Stores a consistent SQLite backup in Home Assistant's .storage/si_grid_monitor_backups folder before deletion.

confirm_archive_deletion.title: Confirm permanent archive deletion
confirm_archive_deletion.description: This cannot be undone from SI Grid Monitor. Type exactly {confirmation}, then remove {meter} within 10 minutes. After that, authorization expires and removal keeps the archive.

data_description.archive_removal_confirmation: This entry-scoped authorization expires after 10 minutes and protects other configured meters and their archives from accidental deletion.
